text: Entry Requirements Be a non-Chinese citizen. Be physically and mentally healthy, and aged between 18 and 25 years old，be friendly to China. Holda high school graduation certificate recognized by the Chinese government. Meet the Chinese language requirement: HSK Level 4 with a score of 180 or above. Hold a score certificate of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA Exam).( The specific CSCA exam subjects are detailed in the Category of Bachelor’s Programs for International Students ).
